name: ShopHours Guard for WooCommerce
author: Asif Ali

sections.description:
ShopHours Guard for WooCommerce allows store owners to define weekly closed days and specific time ranges when the store should not accept orders.

During the configured closed schedule:
– Add to Cart buttons are hidden
– Quantity input fields are hidden
– A custom styled message is displayed to customers
– Adding products to cart is blocked
– Checkout is prevented with a notice

This is useful for businesses that operate only during specific hours or days and want to prevent orders outside operating time.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Store Timing to configure closed days and hours
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I customize the message style?

Yes. You can set message color, font size, and font weight from settings.
